name: Gertrude Nellie Simons (Masters, Groves)
milestones: Buried in Winlock Cemetery, Winlock, Washington
sources: Find a Grave, memorial 14101134 (via Ancestry.com, U.S., Find a Grave Index)
notes: Born 16 May 1879 in Minnesota, the eldest child of Aaron and Hattie Simons; died 18 Jun 1947 at Winlock, Lewis County, Washington.

Married Charles F. Masters on 12 Sep 1898 at Benton Harbor, Michigan (divorced 17 Dec 1901), then Daniel Harvey "Dan" Groves on 8 Sep 1906 at North Yakima, Washington; the 1906 return calls it her first marriage.
